title: 2.0 Ultimate Data Science & GenAI Bootcamp
_comment_overview: PARAPHRASED from the krishnaik.in/learn.krishnaikacademy.com landing page — marketing prose never copied verbatim. Facts (12-month duration, fee, module count, four capstones, framework/tool names) are used as-is.
overview: A 12-month live cohort that takes complete beginners from Python and statistics fundamentals through classical machine learning, deep learning and NLP into generative AI, RAG and multi-agent orchestration with LangChain and LangGraph. Twenty-eight modules combine SQL/NoSQL database work and interactive Streamlit apps with production deployment via Docker, AWS and CI/CD pipelines. It closes with four end-to-end capstones spanning data engineering, machine learning, deep learning and a RAG Q&A system with CI/CD integration.
_comment_category: Primary is unambiguous — the course is structured and marketed as a ground-up data science program ('No Experience Required, Expert on Exit'), with 12 of 28 modules covering Python/stats/classical ML/EDA before advanced topics begin. Secondary 'GenAI / LLM Engineering' for modules 17-20,26 (GenAI fundamentals, vector DBs, RAG, LangChain, MCP); 'Agentic AI' for modules 21-27 (Agentic AI intro through multi-agent research systems); 'NLP' for the dedicated NLP-for-ML and advanced-deep-learning-for-NLP modules (14, 16).
_comment_level: Page states explicitly 'No Experience Required, Expert on Exit' and opens with Python basics/container objects/loops — a true ground-zero anchor, unlike the sibling agentic-ai-agentops-bootcamp-3-0 which requires prior Python/NLP/DL knowledge. It genuinely spans up to multi-agent systems and MCP by module 27-28, hence level_range; `level` alone is what fusion_rank scores, and beginner is the correct anchor for who this course actually admits.
_comment_price: ₹10,000.00 stated inclusive of GST, a flat course fee (not a monthly/EMI figure). Own-site cohort pricing, not coupon-driven, so a number is safe here. Band 'high' per §2 (>=₹10,000).
